usedFor: Tickets raised in Assembla reach HubSpot, where “New Ticket” can create a contact, start a deal or add a note.

bestTemplate.name: “New Ticket” in Assembla, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: It writes a dated note with a body on the HubSpot contact, so whoever owns the relationship sees the ticket.

watchOut: “New Ticket” in Assembla polls on a schedule, so a short delay before HubSpot changes is normal.
